Cancelling an Appointment: German A2 Phrase Exercises

Cancel an appointment clearly and politely in German. Practise absagen, leider and confirmation language without implying a new booking.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Useful phrases and patterns

A cancellation can be brief and clear: Leider muss ich den Termin absagen. Identify the appointment so the other person knows which arrangement you mean. If you want confirmation, ask Könnten Sie mir die Absage kurz bestätigen? A separate sentence can request a new appointment if needed.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not use verschieben when you mean cancelling without agreeing another time. Absagen removes the arrangement; verschieben asks for a different time.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice what the speaker wants to do, the level of politeness and the details the listener needs.

Worked example 1Leider muss ich meinen Termin am Montag absagen.Unfortunately I have to cancel my appointment on Monday.
Worked example 2Es tut mir leid, dass ich so kurzfristig Bescheid gebe.I am sorry to let you know at such short notice.
Worked example 3Könnten Sie mir die Absage bitte kurz bestätigen?Could you briefly confirm the cancellation, please?
Worked example 4Einen neuen Termin würde ich später gern vereinbaren.I would like to arrange a new appointment later.

Practice: complete the phrases

Use the verb or word in brackets to complete the cancellation phrase. Avoid adding any real booking details. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: absagen · Bescheid · bestätigen · leid

Question 1. Ich muss den vereinbarten Termin leider ___. (cancel)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: absagen

Absagen is the cancellation verb.

Question 2. Es tut mir ___, dass ich nicht kommen kann. (sorry)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: leid

The fixed apology is Es tut mir leid.

Question 3. Könnten Sie die Absage ___? (confirm)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: bestätigen

Bestätigen asks for confirmation.

Question 4. Ich gebe Ihnen so früh wie möglich ___. (let you know)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Bescheid

Bescheid geben is the fixed expression for letting someone know.

Use it in your own sentence

Cancel an appointment politely and say you cannot come.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich muss unseren Termin leider absagen, weil ich nicht kommen kann.

Check your wording: Absagen cancels; it does not automatically arrange a replacement.

What to practise next

Adapt a model to a different listener or situation. Keep the request, time reference and formal or informal address consistent.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
